column2: G'day and welcome to Joystick Jammers! Grab a controller and make a spectacular mess.
Scan the code, pick your car, and you're in. No waiting, no worries.
Three! Two! One! Go, go, go!
First lap, and they're already swapping paint!
Final lap! Hold on to your doors, legends!
There goes a door! She'll be right!
Wheel's off! That one's gone walkabout!
And here comes number twelve, rocking up fashionably late!
It's a photo finish! What a ripper of a race!
And the winner is number seven. You beauty!
Next track's loading. Same again? Too right!
